Container.Name: PumpkinManager
Container.Overview: Web dashboard that creates, runs, backs up and automatically updates Pumpkin Minecraft servers (Pumpkin is a fast Minecraft server written in Rust: https://pumpkinmc.org). One container manages as many servers as you like: create one in the dashboard and it is downloaded, configured and started for you. Pumpkin updates are checked automatically; before any update is applied the server is stopped and a verified backup is made, and the manager rolls back on its own if the new version does not start. The first time it starts, the administrator password is printed in the container log unless you set one below.

Config.Name: Game ports (Java, TCP)
Config.Description: Every server you create gets the next free port of this range. Keep the host port range identical to the container range, and identical to the 'Port range' variable below. Add more ports here if you want more servers.

Config.Name: Game ports (query, UDP)
Config.Description: Optional: only needed if you enable the GameSpy4 query protocol on a server. Remove this entry if you do not use it.

Config.Name: Bedrock ports (UDP)
Config.Description: Only needed for servers with Bedrock support enabled (experimental in Pumpkin). Keep host and container identical.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Servers, downloaded Pumpkin binaries and the settings database. Use a path on your cache pool for the best performance.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where backups are stored. Using a share on the array (a different disk than AppData) means a failed cache drive does not take your backups with it.

Config.Name: Backup folder (variable)
Config.Description: Must match the container path of the Backups entry above. Leave unchanged unless you changed that path.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Initial password for the user 'admin' (at least 8 characters). Only used on the very first start; change it later in the dashboard. Leave empty to have one generated and printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the daily backup time and log timestamps, e.g. America/New_York.

Config.Name: Port range (Java)
Config.Description: Ports the manager may assign to servers. Must equal the Java game ports mapping above.

Config.Name: Port range (Bedrock)
Config.Description: UDP ports the manager may assign to Bedrock-enabled servers. Must equal the Bedrock mapping above.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the manager and the servers run as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask. Use 002 if other users on your network shares need to edit server files.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional. Raises GitHub's API rate limit if update checks ever fail with a rate-limit error. No permissions needed.

Config.Name: CurseForge API key
Config.Description: Optional. Needed only for CurseForge modpacks (Modrinth ones work without it). Your own key from console.curseforge.com; it can also be entered in the dashboard under Settings. It is personal, do not share it.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Optional. Host name or IP that is shown to players as the server address (for example a DynDNS name). Defaults to the address you open the dashboard with.

Config.Name: Reverse proxy IPs
Config.Description: Only if you put the dashboard behind a reverse proxy: the proxy's IP address (or * to trust any proxy on your network) so that client addresses and https are detected correctly.
